positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States · Remote

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed, tested, and maintained mission-critical real-time systems in C++ and SQL
•	GUI development and design in MFC, Qt
•	Created software in C++ that automatically generated web pages using HTML, Javascript, and CSS

positions.title: Research Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed algorithms to integrate sensors on the Android platform, created Android apps
•	Developed serial port binary communication protocols and graphical user interface (GUI) for the Boeing Advanced Aerial Refueling Drogue project.

positions.title: Graduate Researcher
positions.description:
•	Developed finite-element and computational geometrical algorithms to simulate grain growth in metals using Matlab, C++ and OpenGl
•	Mathematically modeled metallic grains, microstructure of foam and bone in 3D

positions.title: Database Developer
positions.description:
•	Created databases of patients and medical samples with MySQL.
•	Created user-friendly webpages to search through the databases, and admin pages to maintain the database using HTML, Javascript, PHP, and SQL.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed algorithms for signal processing and noise filtering using Matlab
•	Assembled electronic components onto semiconductors
•	Developed methods to fabricate filtering lenses for use on a next generation bolometer
•	Devised and conducted experiments to test the bolometer's performance

positions.title: Computer Vision Programmer
positions.description:
•	Developed highly efficient algorithms in Matlab, Java and C++ that enabled computer recognition of objects from  real-time video feeds for control experiments. 
•	Applied Kalman filters to predict movement patterns and identify objects between time steps.

positions.title: Jr. Web Developer
positions.description: •	Utilized HTML and Javascript to develop and maintain the UCSD Bookstore website and other UCSD websites.
